substantiveCommits.auditNote: Initial implementation established the support/service-line correction path but a subsequent static audit found that its service-line transform scaling assumed an untouched Unity Cylinder. The detailed bevel pass actually bakes cylinder dimensions into GM_HD mesh assets and resets transform scale to one, so this implementation was superseded in the same run.

substantiveCommits.message: qa: gate native capture on outdoor AC installation

substantiveCommits.auditNote: Corrected the service-line reconstruction to rebuild dimension-baked beveled-cylinder meshes through QualityBlockDetailMeshLibrary and keep transform scale at one. Endpoint validation now derives length from actual mesh bounds, so it supports both untouched Unity Cylinder input and the post-bevel GM_HD representation.

focus: Geometry & construction fidelity / Material-PBR plausibility / outdoor-unit floating-interpenetrating critical risk

sourceDefectFound.assembly: generated balcony outdoor air-conditioner support + service-line installation
evidence: The generated fallback BalconyFloor top is approximately bay-local Y=-0.79 m (floor center -0.85 m, height 0.12 m).
HD_AC_MountPlate_±1 was authored at Y=-0.817 m with height 0.018 m, giving a top near -0.808 m: the whole plate is inside the 0.12 m balcony-floor volume rather than sitting on its top surface.
HD_AC_Foot_±1 was authored at Y=-0.785 m with height 0.045 m, giving a bottom near -0.8075 m: roughly 17.5 mm of the support foot penetrates the slab.

The base AC casing is 0.48 m high centered at bay-local Y=-0.53 m, placing its lower face near -0.77 m. A physically legible plate+foot stack above the slab therefore requires moving the casing and casing-mounted detail upward instead of leaving support hardware buried.

Paired refrigerant pipes and the drain hose were dimensioned from the old unit-side elevations. Raising only the casing would disconnect those services, so the unit-side endpoints must move while the wall-side collar and slab-relative drain termination remain fixed interfaces.

implementation.manufactureInstallationReasoning: Model the balcony condenser as a separate manufactured appliance supported by two mounting plates and two feet above the RC balcony slab. The chassis is supported by the feet with only a small controlled overlap; visible fastener heads remain above their plates; paired insulated refrigerant lines continuously connect moved unit-side outlets to fixed wall-side interfaces; a low condensate hose terminates slightly above the slab. Wall collar and clips remain facade-fixed rather than following the moved appliance.
implementation.materialReasoning: The contract separates aged dielectric AC casing/plastic, darker fan/grille components, galvanized/protected mounting hardware, matte insulated refrigerant lines and matte polymer drain hose. It records albedo/roughness/metallic-or-F0/normal-scale/microstructure/wetness/UV-aging/angular-Fresnel guidance per material class and prohibits painted edge illumination.
implementation.lodReasoning: LOD0 retains fan, grille, support stack, visible fastener heads, paired refrigerant lines, drain, collar and clips; LOD1/2 progressively simplify microgeometry while preserving mounting gap and service-line silhouette; LOD3 may simplify further but may not expose a stock primitive in benchmark framing. Actual transition stability remains render/temporal evidence only.
implementation.authoritativeOrder: The Complete Native 4K Review Packet validates the AC installation contract, builds the final scene, applies and persists balcony-rail/slab correction, applies and persists AC support/service correction, validates it before realtime reflection rendering, validates it again after probe completion immediately before Camera.Render, and validates it again after still sealing before temporal capture.

staticAudit.importantCorrectionWithinRun: The first AC implementation attempted to re-scale service-line transforms. Static inspection of QualityBlockDetailBevelUpgrade and QualityBlockDetailMeshLibrary showed that high-detail cylinders are converted to dimension-baked GM_HD meshes and their transform scale is reset to one. The final implementation therefore rebuilds the actual beveled mesh asset for the new line length/diameter and keeps scale=1. This prevents a source-side regression where pipes could become incorrectly scaled after the bevel pass.
staticAudit.finalEndpointMethod: Service-line endpoint validation uses sharedMesh.bounds.extents.y multiplied by localScale.y and the transform's local rotation. This works for both an untouched Unity Cylinder and the dimension-baked GM_HD representation used in the prepared scene.

research.usePolicy: Manufacturer material is used only to ground physical support/anchoring/drainage/service-line principles. No exact product identity or modern dimension is projected backward onto the circa-2000 benchmark.

implementationReadiness.reason: This run reduces a concrete source-level construction risk and strengthens the authoritative render preflight, but the existing readiness model still withholds 7 points for missing Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime verification.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Geometry & construction fidelity (20): replaces a source arrangement with buried mounting plates and slab-penetrating feet by a measurable slab -> plate -> foot -> chassis interface; preserves connected service geometry when the chassis moves.

Material/PBR physical plausibility (20): codifies distinct dielectric casing/insulation/hose response versus restrained galvanized hardware response and prevents painted-highlight reasoning from substituting for real angular light response.

Lighting/shadows/reflections (15): physically separated support contacts and continuous pipes can produce causal contact shadow, occlusion and grazing response after reflection probes are regenerated from the corrected persisted scene; no points are awarded until observed.
Weathering/context causality (10): ordinary splash/contact grime, UV exposure, insulation aging and condensate wetting are constrained to physically causal zones rather than uniform random noise.

Critical-defect integrity: source risk for floating/interpenetrating hero geometry, primitive-looking service geometry, impossible material response and missing assembly metadata is reduced but not cleared without actual native-4K evidence.
lookdevVerificationPriority: oblique/balcony_services 100% crop: inspect plate-on-slab and foot-on-plate seating, casing/foot overlap, visible mount-bolt heads, line joints, wall collar and drain/slab clearance
hero/facade_center: confirm repeated outdoor units read as supported manufactured appliances rather than floating boxes while avoiding visually obvious module sameness
grazing/sash_rail_response or nearest AC-visible grazing crop: verify broad dielectric casing response separates from galvanized hardware and matte insulation/hose without painted edge highlights
temporal/lod walk: reject any support/service-line disappearance, LOD pop or shimmer introduced by future LOD simplification
correctivePolicyIfRuntimeFails: Do not loosen contact, embed, pipe-joint or drain-clearance tolerances merely to pass QA. Use the runtime report and sealed 100% crops to identify the wrong interface, fix the generator/correction geometry or authored replacement, rerun reflection synchronization, and recapture the same benchmark evidence.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile and execution. At first availability, stop speculative expansion and run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. If compilation or ac_outdoor_unit_installation_runtime_report.json fails, fix the concrete API/geometry defect first. If source/runtime QA passes, inspect oblique/balcony_services at 100% before scoring any category.
